recognize_zh: 三色染色（trichrome）下藍色的骨小樑增厚，骨小樑之間的骨髓空間被紡錘形細胞與藍色膠原纖維取代，造血細胞幾乎消失，代表膠原性纖維化（MF-3）合併骨硬化。
features: Intertrabecular space replaced by fibrous stroma with spindle cells
Blue-staining collagen fibers within the marrow space indicating collagen fibrosis
Near absence of normal hematopoietic cells
describe_en: Masson trichrome stain of the bone marrow biopsy shows thickened bony trabeculae and an intertrabecular space replaced by a fibrovascular stroma of spindle cells and blue-staining collagen fibers. Dilated thin-walled vascular spaces are present, and normal hematopoietic cells are nearly absent. Findings indicate collagen fibrosis with osteosclerosis (MF-3), consistent with advanced primary myelofibrosis in the appropriate clinical and molecular context.

ddx.vs: Desmoplastic metastasis contains cohesive keratin-positive tumor cell nests within the collagen, which are not seen here.
Paget disease shows mosaic cement lines with prominent osteoclasts and osteoblasts and loose fibrovascular marrow, without MPN megakaryocytes or peripheral blood leukoerythroblastosis.
Therapy-related fibrosis follows a clinical history of treatment and lacks the clustered atypical megakaryocytes and driver mutations of PMF.
